description: Owl's strict verdict (verifyIntegrityStrict, scripts/biomesh-core.js at the pinned O3 commit) for a value given to a strict verifier (RFC 07 sections 12.3 and 12.4): ok and the first failing check (parity, canonical, crystal, leaves, weaves, derived). Values are honest shdccp2_record records altered in one way (informative.base), records assembled from other chunks or bytes with Owl's codec functions, and values that are not records. informative gives Owl's legacy flag (informative because the independent verifier has no notion of legacy), Owl's detail, the self-consistency check of section 12.2 (Owl's verifyIntegrity at the generator's pin) and the label of section 12.4. The independent verifier (the Lexicon's verifyPackage, steps 1-6) gives the same verdict on every case.
